videos.script: A cache saves the database a thousand queries a second. Then one key expires. {{expire}} For a tenth of a second, every visitor misses. Every one of them asks the database the same question, at the same moment. {{herd}} The database slows down. The window gets wider. More visitors fall into it. {{spiral}} That is a stampede, and it is the failure you are most likely to meet in production. {{name}} In this lesson you cause one, with fifty readers and one book. Then you stop it four ways. {{four}} A lock, so one reader fetches and the rest wait. An old copy, served while one reader refreshes. A refresh that comes early, by chance. And lifetimes that stop agreeing with each other. {{fixes}} Then the same stampede in Nginx, fixed with one line. And the cold start, after a restart, when there is nothing to serve at all. {{cold}}
